name: Barzillai
title: The Faithful Gileadite
summary: Barzillai was a wealthy and influential man from Gilead who showed great loyalty to King David during Absalom's rebellion. He provided food and supplies for David and his men while they were fleeing, and his faithfulness was highly valued by the king.

keyEvents.title: Helps David During His Flight
keyEvents.description: When David fled from Absalom and arrived at Mahanaim, Barzillai, along with other loyal men, brought beds, food, and necessary supplies to the king and his weary followers.

keyEvents.title: David Invites Him to Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: After defeating Absalom, David wanted to reward Barzillai by taking him to Jerusalem and providing for him at the court for the rest of his life.

keyEvents.title: Refuses the King's Offer
keyEvents.description: The 80-year-old Barzillai humbly declined David's offer, explaining that he was too old to enjoy the pleasures of the court, and asked to die in his own city near the grave of his parents.

keyEvents.title: Sends Kimham in His Place
keyEvents.description: Instead of going himself, Barzillai sent his son Kimham with David so that he might receive the king's favor and blessing.

keyEvents.title: David's Final Wish Regarding His Descendants
keyEvents.description: On his deathbed, David instructed his son Solomon to show kindness to Barzillai's sons and let them eat at the king's table, as a reward for their help during his flight from Absalom.
